Subject: Request: Shorter log retention for forensic exports

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team has one open item before procurement can sign: ZendiQ needs a narrow, timeboxed exception to Redwood's default operational log retention for a dedicated forensic export used in regulated investigations. Specifically: can Redwood produce a contractual amendment or waiver that limits log retention for the exported forensic dataset to 90 days (instead of your standard 12 months) and provides the CAIQ/SIG evidence bundle describing collection/retention controls?

We have attached a spreadsheet of the fields we need retained and a high-level legal note. Key asks:
- 90-day TTL on the exported forensic bucket
- Proof of deletion (audit log entry or deletion job manifest) after 90 days
- A statement of the controls that prevent cross-tenant leakage for the export

Can you confirm feasibility and next steps (legal review, SOC2 evidence we can provide to our auditors)? We are trying to close by EOW for procurement.

Attachments: zendiq_forensic_requirements.xlsx

Thanks,
Jordan Lee

Thanks team — I've reviewed the requirement and we can approve a narrow, timeboxed waiver with the following mandatory controls and acceptance criteria: 

1) Scope: The waiver applies only to exported forensic datasets described in the attached schema (zendiq_forensic_requirements.xlsx). It does NOT apply to platform audit logs, billing logs, or any other system telemetry.

2) TTL: 90 days from export creation timestamp. Deletion must be performed by an automated job; manual deletion is not sufficient unless accompanied by a justification and a signed exception from Redwood Legal.

3) Proof of deletion: Redwood will provide a deletion manifest including export ID, deletion timestamps (ISO 8601), the identity of the service account that performed deletion, and a SHA256 hash of the manifest. Manifests will be retained for 1 year for audit purposes.

4) Isolation & encryption: Exported data must be stored in a customer-designated bucket with server-side encryption enabled; we will restrict network access via VPC or signed URL with a 24-hour TTL per object.

5) Auditability: Redwood will include the waiver clause and attestation as an addendum to the customer's SLA and will deliver a signed attestation within 5 business days of each quarterly export (or after the final export, if exports are ad hoc).

6) Termination: If ZendiQ requests restoration beyond 90 days, it must be escalated and approved by Redwood Legal; restoration is not guaranteed.

I attach a waiver template (redwood_waiver_template.docx) and a redlined SLA excerpt (zendiq_sla_redline_20270429.pdf). Once you confirm, I'll prepare the final addendum for signature (DocuSign link to follow).
